basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old gamer primarily interested in action RPGs and narrative-heavy games. I live in Amsterdam and work as a junior web developer. I usually browse Reddit during evenings, especially after work, and sometimes on weekends. I recently got into Formula 1, and I'm a huge Max Verstappen fan. I'm currently single and enjoy a laid-back lifestyle. While I love gaming, I also spend time following web development trends and learning new programming languages.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, which is where I developed my interest in technology and web development. Most of my gaming knowledge comes from years of playing and discussing games with friends and online communities. I've recently started learning more about motorsports, particularly Formula 1.
